_comment: All pixel coordinates are expressed in REFERENCE FRAME space (see reference_size),
which matches reference.jpg. They are rescaled to the native video resolution at runtime,
and warped by the per-clip alignment transform to compensate for camera drift.
Speed first uses a two-gate speed trap. If a triggered clip starts after one gate,
the ground-plane homography maps the full track to feet and fits distance vs time.
The two gates are drawn through each mailbox post base, both aimed at 'cross_road_vanishing_point'.
That makes the gates PARALLEL on the ground plane, so the 28.8 ft separation holds for
either lane rather than only at the shoulder. Retune that point if speeds look lane-biased.
baseline_note: Laser-measured, inside face of mailbox 507 to inside face of the neighbour's mailbox.
road_vanishing_point_note: Intersection of the near and far asphalt-edge lines in reference.jpg. Replace with a multi-track fit when more clips are available.

ground_plane.axis_note: Origin is the left driveway/asphalt corner. X runs right along the road; Y runs across the road away from the camera.
ground_plane.measurement_note: 16.92 ft driveway width; 20.07/30.57 ft from left/right corners to manhole; 20.42 ft across road at left corner.
ground_plane.quality_note: The far-road-edge pixel is estimated from the reference image. Replace it using a visible marker at the measured endpoint for evidence-grade calibration.
